svg.title: PB-HY-001 HYBRID paddle - rib core
svg.text: SCALE 1:2 · BOTTOM LANDS OFFSET ½ PITCH
SCALE 2:1 · ON THE CENTRE LAND (x = 0), RUN-OUT FROM y = 150; TOP FLUTES MIRROR IT
MATERIAL: PA-CF (CARBON-FIBRE-FILLED NYLON), E ≈ 4 GPa, ρ 1.18 g/cm³. DRY THE FILAMENT BEFORE PRINTING.
PRINT FLAT, 100 % SOLID: WALL 1.6 = 4 PERIMETERS (0.4 NOZZLE), 0.2 LAYERS. NO SUPPORTS (45° RUN-OUTS).
THICKNESS 8 ±0.1. BOTH FACES ARE BOND SURFACES, FLAT WITHIN 0.1.
WAVE RIB λ18, WALL 1.6, CENTRE-LINE AMPLITUDE 4; CRESTS CUT FLAT = LANDS 4.25 ON BOTH FACES.
FRAME 6, CLOSED. SOLID TO y = 150; EACH FLUTE STARTS WITH A 45° RUN-OUT, 8 LONG (D–D).
M3 HEAT-SET INSERT BORE Ø4 × 7 + Ø3.2 × 15 IN THE BUTT FACE (GRIP SCREW) – SEE PB-GR-002.
BONDING: ABRADE (P120), DEGREASE, STRUCTURAL EPOXY, FILLET EVERY LAND EDGE.
PRINT FILES output/rib_support/: hybrid_rib_support_1piece.stl (BED ≥ 390 × 205) OR _2piece_A + _B (256 BED):
7 SOLID SPLICE BAND AT y = 240, DOVETAIL JOINT 0.1 CLEARANCE PER SIDE - GLUE IT BEFORE BONDING THE SHEETS.
MASS 170 g. y FROM THE GRIP BUTT FACE (y = 0); THE RIB SUPPORT STARTS AT y = 5.
